goal: On the CPPP 'Latest Active Tenders' list, find tenders related to 'storage rack' (match on title). For each matching row read: bid_no (the tender reference number / tender ID), title, buyer (organisation name), end_date (bid submission closing date), doc_url (absolute link of the tender title). Today is 25 Oct 2026. Only keep bids closing on or after 27 Oct 2026 (skip anything closing sooner). Relevance: keep a bid only if its items/title describe 'storage rack' itself or a close variant; never keep a bid just because the ministry, department or organisation name contains a search word. Return at most 10 bids. If a captcha, OTP or login wall appears, do NOT try to solve it: stop immediately and return blocked=true with blocked_reason and an empty bids list. blocked is ONLY for captcha/login/site errors: if the site works but nothing relevant is found, return blocked=false and an empty bids list. This is read-only: never click submit, participate, or bid buttons. Copy values exactly as shown (end_date with its time, est_value in INR as shown); use absolute URLs for doc_url; use an empty string for anything not shown.

steps.message: Navigate to Latest Active Tenders page
Enter search term for storage rack tender title
Read captcha text to enter it
Check current captcha text after refresh
Submit search for storage rack tenders
Navigate to Latest Active Tenders page again
Check captcha text and tender results
Go to the main page to get full table data
Extract all tender rows from search results
Extract detailed tender information from all 3 rows
Extract official tender reference numbers (bid_no) from each row
Verify closing dates for date filtering
